note: Closed registry of reference aliases. An operator names what it reads by alias; the alias says exactly where that thing lives, how it is bound, and who may write it. `<Source>` is the host repository that owns this .claude (its parent directory). `<checkout:project/role>` is the diskPath of the hydrated route .workspaces/local/routes/<project>/<role>/config.json. A segment in angle brackets is a parameter the invocation supplies. `kind` file/dir/checkout resolve on disk; service resolves through a runtime endpoint; caller-supplied comes from the input.

@source.bind: fingerprint + sourceHead (git rev-parse HEAD of the checkout)
@source.purpose: The routed repository checkout. Observation is evidence discovery, never permission to mutate.

@declaration.purpose: Portable route declaration, tracked. The only place a route is declared.

@route.purpose: Machine-local hydrated route; projects the declaration onto this disk. Ignored by Git.

@ports.purpose: Port projection: project offset and application slots. Endpoints are derived, never typed.

@identity.bind: fingerprint; the sealed keys under <Source>/.workspaces/local/credentials/*.key.enc are bound by name and never read
@identity.purpose: Machine identity and the encrypted credential roster reference.

@runtime.purpose: The shared runtime owner registry: generation, status, endpoints, health evidence. Callers consume, never own.

@knowledge.bind: fingerprint; the rule inventory is the set of `## PREFIX-n` headings of the file
@knowledge.purpose: Canonical English knowledge: ui/composition, ui/presentation, ui/proof, grammars/<family>, patterns/fe, patterns/be. The .vi.md mirror is never bound.

@grammar.bind: fingerprint of packages/grammar/package.json (manifestRef) + the checkout head
@grammar.purpose: The published @starci/grammar package: Common renderers, props, owned relationships, and the Core family.

@business.bind: content address from <Source>/.worktrees/businesses/business-registry-v1.json (featureHeads.<featureId>.head) with its authorityStatus
@business.purpose: The business promise head. The businesses root is its own git worktree; a head binds by content address even before its commit lands.

@session.purpose: Per-session working records: leases, inventories, blockers, and the artifacts of that session's invocations.

@artifacts.bind: fingerprint per artifact; every artifact an operator writes is registered in output.artifactRefs
@artifacts.purpose: The only place an operator writes: its receipt and named artifacts. Nothing else is a write.

@receipt.resolvesTo: <@artifacts of invocation <invocationId>>/<receiptType>.json (the receipt file that invocation registered in output.artifactRefs)
@receipt.bind: fingerprint + the sourceHead the receipt binds
@receipt.purpose: A predecessor's typed receipt, consumed unchanged: business-promise-authority, architecture-decision, fe-direction-decision, fe-presentation-resolution, fe-source-application, fe-surface-audit, backend-implementation, quality-verification, uat-flow-verification, release-deployment, platform-operation-receipt, content-generation-receipt, git-publication, workspace-route-binding.

@uat.purpose: Canonical UAT pair per flow and case: the frozen snapshot and the published result. Never carries a credential.

@debts.purpose: Owner-approved quality debts (be.md, fe.md, and per-item files). A debt without a live approval here is not a debt.

@templates.purpose: Authority templates for new business heads, debts, sessions, and UAT pairs. Consumed, never modified.

@screenshots.purpose: Pixel evidence from earlier audits. Evidence only; never a layout template.

@hooks.bind: fingerprint per hook file at the checkout head
@hooks.purpose: The pre-commit and pre-push hooks a publish must run. A blocked hook is a typed failure, never a reason to bypass.

@gates.resolvesTo: <checkout:project/role>/package.json#scripts plus the configs it names (eslint, tsconfig, jest/vitest, sonar-project.properties)
@gates.bind: fingerprint of each file at the checkout head
@gates.purpose: The pinned gate commands and their configuration. A gate is measured with these, never with a substitute.

@remote.bind: observed remote head (git ls-remote) at invocation time
@remote.purpose: The publication target. Fast-forwardness is decided against this observation.

@content.resolvesTo: MinIO object contents/<contentId>/<locale>.json through the routed runtime
@content.purpose: Authored lesson content as served, not as drafted.

@oci.purpose: Immutable release images. A tag is never a binding; a digest is.

@workflow-run.resolvesTo: GitHub Actions run <runId> of the routed repository
@workflow-run.purpose: Deployment and verification evidence produced by CI, read only.
